subject: Ciências
description_pt: Comparar diferentes amostras de solo do entorno da escola com base em características como cor, textura, cheiro, tamanho das partículas, permeabilidade etc.

components.description_pt: Observar e descrever características de amostras de solo como cor, textura e odor
components.description_en: Observe and describe characteristics of soil samples such as color, texture, and smell
components.cc_component_description: Describe and classify matter using observable properties such as color, texture, hardness, and flexibility

components.description_pt: Comparar diferentes amostras de solo baseado no tamanho das partículas e permeabilidade
components.description_en: Compare different soil samples based on particle size and permeability
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between different materials based on quantitative measurements of their physical properties

components.description_pt: Registrar e classificar amostras de solo do entorno da escola baseado em características observáveis
components.description_en: Record and classify soil samples from the school's surroundings based on observable characteristics
components.cc_component_description: Classify materials into groups based on shared observable properties such as color, texture, hardness, or flexibility

cc_matches.description: Different kinds of matter exist and many of them can be either solid or liquid, depending on temperature. Matter can be described and classified by its observable properties.
Make observations and measurements to identify materials based on their properties.
Plan and conduct an investigation to describe and classify different kinds of materials by their observable properties.
